hook: Your car can drive on the lowest dry land on Earth.
title: Drive On Earth's Lowest Dry Land
description:
The Dead Sea shore is the lowest dry land on Earth, more than 400 metres below sea level. The water is so salty that people float and read a newspaper on it. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #Geography #PlacesThatShouldntExist
comment_prompt: Would you float here? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your car can drive on the lowest dry land on Earth.
scenes.headline: LOWEST DRY LAND

scenes.narration: It is the Dead Sea shore.
scenes.headline: THE DEAD SEA

scenes.narration: It sits over 400 metres below sea level.
scenes.headline: BELOW SEA LEVEL

scenes.narration: The water is so salty that you cannot sink.
scenes.headline: TOO SALTY TO SINK

scenes.narration: People float and read a newspaper on it.
scenes.headline: READING ON WATER

scenes.narration: No swimming needed, you just lie back.
scenes.headline: JUST LIE BACK

scenes.narration: Fish cannot live in it, so it is called dead.
scenes.headline: NO FISH LIVE HERE

scenes.narration: So you drive on the lowest land, then float.
scenes.headline: DRIVE THEN FLOAT

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a place where the ground becomes sky.
scenes.headline: NEXT: GROUND BECOMES SKY
